description: Legacy access-control category for failures in permissions, privileges, or authorization enforcement.
pattern: cwe-264 permissions privileges access-control authorization acl role privilege owner permission enforcement
remediation: Enforce trusted authorization, role, ownership, and permission checks.

cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.
pattern: cwe-1321 prototype-pollution __proto__ constructor prototype object-key property-key merge assign recursive-merge
remediation: Reject prototype keys and use schema-constrained object updates.

cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
description: Memory operations access outside the intended buffer boundary.
pattern: cwe-119 memory-buffer bounds pointer overflow underflow memcpy strcpy allocation index length out-of-bounds read write
remediation: Validate buffer sizes, offsets, indexes, and memory-copy lengths.

description: Security-critical data assumed immutable can be modified by an attacker.
pattern: cwe-471 assumed-immutable immutable-data hidden-field cookie reverse-dns attacker-modified trusted-value mutable security-decision
remediation: Do not trust client-modifiable values as immutable security state.

description: A security-relevant comparison checks the wrong, incomplete, or non-canonical value.
pattern: cwe-697 incorrect-comparison equality compare comparator mismatch canonicalization hostname url signature token partial-comparison substring
remediation: Compare canonical complete values with the intended security predicate.

description: A read accesses memory before or beyond the valid buffer range.
pattern: cwe-125 out-of-bounds-read buffer-read memory-read index offset length parser decode malformed-input boundary
remediation: Check read offsets, indexes, and lengths before buffer access.

description: Legacy category for failures in explicit software security features.
pattern: cwe-254 security-feature authentication authorization confidentiality integrity cryptography privilege-management protection-mechanism
remediation: Apply the intended security feature consistently at the trusted boundary.

description: An access-control policy is missing or incorrectly enforced for a protected resource.
pattern: cwe-284 access-control authorization permission acl role owner ownership privilege protected-resource protected-endpoint allow deny
remediation: Require explicit server-side authorization before protected operations.

description: Legacy category for cryptographic design or implementation weaknesses.
pattern: cwe-310 cryptography cipher encryption decryption tls ssl certificate hash randomness key cryptographic-protocol
remediation: Use approved cryptographic algorithms, protocols, keys, and certificate validation.

cwe_name: Information Exposure Through Debug Log Files
description: Sensitive information is written to debug or diagnostic log files.
pattern: cwe-534 debug-log diagnostic-log verbose-log sensitive-log password token credential secret exception stacktrace logging
remediation: Redact secrets and disable sensitive diagnostic logging.

cwe_name: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
description: File access follows a symlink, hardlink, or shortcut to an unintended resource.
pattern: cwe-59 symlink hardlink link-following symbolic-link file-link archive-extraction path-resolution file-overwrite race filesystem
remediation: Reject unsafe links and verify resolved file targets before access.

cwe_name: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere
description: A protected resource crosses its intended trust or control boundary and becomes accessible to an unintended actor.
pattern: cwe-668 wrong-sphere control-sphere trust-boundary resource-exposure unintended-actor private-resource public-exposure insecure-permission cross-boundary
remediation: Keep protected resources inside their intended trust boundary.

description: An authorization check exists but evaluates access incorrectly.
pattern: cwe-863 incorrect-authorization authorization-check permission-check role-check ownership-check acl-check access-decision bypass
remediation: Evaluate authorization from trusted server-side identity and policy state.

cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
description: Untrusted CR or LF characters are not neutralized before use in line-delimited protocol metadata.
pattern: cwe-93 crlf-injection carriage-return line-feed newline header response-splitting http-header redirect cookie
remediation: Reject CR/LF in protocol metadata and use validating framework APIs.

description: Legacy category for incorrect handling or transformation of structured data.
pattern: cwe-19 data-processing parser parsing malformed-data format-conversion serialization transformation structured-data processing-error
remediation: Validate structured input and use safe parsing and conversion routines.

description: Legacy category for insecure credential creation, storage, validation, or handling.
pattern: cwe-255 credential-management password token secret credential storage rotation validation authentication-secret
remediation: Protect credentials throughout storage, validation, transport, and rotation.

description: Sensitive data is stored or transmitted without required encryption.
pattern: cwe-311 missing-encryption cleartext plaintext sensitive-data unencrypted storage transmission tls data-at-rest data-in-transit
remediation: Encrypt sensitive data in transit and at rest.

description: A restricted route, URL, script, or file can be requested directly without required authorization.
pattern: cwe-425 forced-browsing direct-request restricted-url protected-route protected-file missing-authorization route endpoint hidden-link
remediation: Authorize every protected route and resource on direct access.

cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
description: Externally influenced data changes the syntax or meaning of a command sent to a downstream command interpreter.
pattern: cwe-77 command-injection command-construction shell exec spawn process subprocess child_process os.system popen argument-delimiter metacharacter
remediation: Keep external data separate from command syntax and use safe argument APIs.
